question_or_proposition: For Cadmium at Outfall 001 during Federal FY2025, does the permit row in PART I Section A establish any enforceable numeric effluent limitation (mass or concentration, for any stated averaging period), or does it establish only a monitoring-and-reporting requirement with no numeric limit applicable for compliance comparison?
required_context: PART I Section A introductory language authorizing discharge subject to the limits and monitoring specified in the table
Permit limit table column headers distinguishing mass limits, concentration limits, and averaging periods (30-day average, daily max, 7-day average)
The Cadmium row pattern of N/A entries across all limit columns with Report in the 7-day average concentration column, measurement frequency 1/Quarter, and sample type Grab
Contrasting pollutant rows in the same table that specify numeric limits (e.g., Cyanide with ug/L limits)
notes: The nominated span is a single table row where every limit cell is N/A except one Report entry; Purpose A explicitly requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from report-only monitoring. Purpose B monitoring frequency (1/Quarter, Grab) appears explicit in the row; Purpose C turns on missing-result states rather than limit-type interpretation of this row.
